business_overview.one_sentence: The group operates tin mining through a 50% interest in the Renison underground mine in Tasmania, Australia, and sells tin concentrate mainly under a connected tin supply contract.

segments.name: Tin mining operation
segments.business_substance: sale of tin concentrate from Renison mine entitlement
segments.source: Annual Report 2023 chairman statement and note 5

business_overview.revenue_model: Tin concentrate sales; YTPAH was entitled to 4,766 tonnes of tin metal available for sale in 2023 from its 50% Renison interest.
business_notes: Revenue under the New Tin Supply Contract with YTATR was HK$820,875,000 for 2023.
The company is an investment holding company; the operating asset is a mining operation with commodity price and capital expenditure cycle exposure.
